Class SpinOffHistoryBasisService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.instrument.SpinOffHistoryBasisService
@Service public class SpinOffHistoryBasisService extends Object
Decides the history basis of every recorded spin-off of a parent before a full reload of its history. It must run before the stored quotes are deleted, because the stored series serves as reference, and in the transaction of the reload, so that a failed reload rolls the decision back. The reload that follows stores the delivered quotes through SpinOffProviderAdjustment, which applies the decision.

  • Method Details

    • describe

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public SpinOffProviderSplitsDto describe(Integer idSecurityOld, LocalDate actionDate)
      Collects what the administrator needs to judge the provider split and the history basis of a spin-off of the parent on the given date, recorded or not yet recorded. Reads the split connector and the history connector of the parent, so it takes as long as two connector requests.
      Parameters:
      idSecurityOld - the parent security
      actionDate - the action date
      Returns:
      the provider splits around the date, the recorded history basis and the price steps

    • decide

      @Transactional public void decide(Security parent)
      Decides and stores the history basis of each spin-off of the parent. Does nothing for a security without spin-offs or without an available history connector.
      Parameters:
      parent - the security whose history is about to be reloaded in full

    • readDelivered

      public List<Historyquote> readDelivered(Security parent, LocalDate actionDate)
      Reads the delivered quotes of the window around an action date directly from the history connector, without the revert of SpinOffProviderAdjustment.
      Parameters:
      parent - the parent security
      actionDate - the action date
      Returns:
      the delivered quotes, empty when the connector is unavailable or fails
